title: Detailed mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Phone body -->
  <rect x='28' y='6' width='44' height='88' rx='8' ry='8' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- Body edge highlight -->
  <rect x='28' y='6' width='44' height='88' rx='8' ry='8' fill='none' stroke='#5a7aa0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Screen bezel -->
  <rect x='33' y='16' width='34' height='64' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#1a2a44'/>
  <!-- Screen display -->
  <rect x='35' y='18' width='30' height='60' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#2a6a9a'/>
  <!-- Screen content: wallpaper gradient -->
  <rect x='35' y='18' width='30' height='24' rx='2' ry='2' fill='#4aa0d0'/>
  <rect x='35' y='42' width='30' height='3' fill='#3a90c0'/>
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x='37' y='20' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aaddf0'/>
  <rect x='43' y='20' width='3' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aaddf0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='20' width='3' height='2' rx='1' fill='#aaddf0'/>
  <!-- Signal bars -->
  <rect x='55' y='21' width='1' height='1' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <rect x='57' y='20' width='1' height='2' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <rect x='59' y='19' width='1' height='3' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <!-- Battery -->
  <rect x='61' y='20' width='3' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#cceeff'/>
  <!-- App icons grid -->
  <rect x='37' y='46' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#4ad04a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='46' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#d0a040'/>
  <rect x='55' y='46' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#d05050'/>
  <rect x='37' y='55' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#a040d0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='55' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#40c0c0'/>
  <rect x='55' y='55' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e0e040'/>
  <rect x='37' y='64' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e08040'/>
  <rect x='46' y='64' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#4080e0'/>
  <rect x='55' y='64' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#e040a0'/>
  <!-- Dock bar -->
  <rect x='37' y='73' width='26' height='2' rx='1' fill='#3a80b0'/>
  <!-- Home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='4' fill='#4a5a7b'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='86' r='3' fill='#2a3a5b'/>
  <!-- Speaker grille -->
  <rect x='44' y='10' width='12' height='2' rx='1' fill='#5a7aa0'/>
  <!-- Front camera -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='11' r='1.5' fill='#6a8ab0'/>
  <!-- Volume buttons -->
  <rect x='26' y='30' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#5a7aa0'/>
  <rect x='26' y='40' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#5a7aa0'/>
  <!-- Power button -->
  <rect x='72' y='32' width='2' height='8' rx='1' fill='#5a7aa0'/>
</svg>
